messages:
Sam (CEO): short thread after today's Q&A: list one-line win reasons, loss reasons, and one action each. keep it concise.
Priya (Product): agreed format: win / loss / product ask.
Diego (Sales): Win: adtech startup chose Dedicated for predictable tail latency under bursty workloads.
Diego (Sales): Loss: large healthcare prospect dropped due to missing private deployment in their cloud region and lack of an example DPA.
Hannah (Customer Success): Recurring ask: an onboarding checklist and sample VPC peering config. Mentioned in 4 deals this quarter.
Owen (Eng): Technical loss notes: 1) region absence for Private, 2) occasional 99th-percentile latency spikes on long-context models.
Marta (Data): Prompt note: chained system prompts caused quality regressions ~6% on customer-specific evals when using lower-KV quantized profiles.
Priya (Product): Proposed fast actions: (1) onboarding starter kit (Hannah), (2) latency-routing flag (Owen), (3) Dedicated vs Hosted one-pager (Diego).
Diego (Sales): I'll draft the one-pager + procurement checklist.
Hannah (Customer Success): I'll assemble the starter kit + webinar. target pilot in 10 business days.
Owen (Eng): I'll build a latency-first routing policy and a minimal terraform example for the starter kit. est 2-3w for API + Console toggle.
Marta (Data): I'll run prompt-sensitivity reports for top lost deals; deliver in 5 working days.
Sam (CEO): leadership ask: list 3 shipable items in <=8 weeks with owners and blockers. keep updates here.
Priya (Product): Items: starter kit (Hannah, 2w), routing flag + Console (Owen, 3w), procurement one-pager (Diego, 3d).
Diego (Sales): blocker: Legal asked for DPA template for Dedicated.
Priya (Product): I'll ping Legal. Diego, send their list of legal asks.
Owen (Eng): blocker: need validation runs for quantized kernels on certain GPU types; scheduling infra time.
All-Hands Bot: action items saved to notes (https://redwood.example.co/all-hands/2119990001/actions).
Sam (CEO): thanks all, keep updates in this thread. concise please.
